name: Emeralds main parking area on Bowman Lake Road, across the Yuba River bridge
basis: Mountain Project The Emeralds page: from Hwy 20 turn north on Bowman Lake Road (FS 18) 1.3 mi paved; dirt access road before the Yuba River bridge is gated, 'park across the bridge'; bathrooms at main parking area. Page coordinate 39.31876,-120.65678 matches this mapped lot (~15 m); matched by position.
